rules.name: Over-Privileged Administrative Wildcard Permission
rules.remediation: Enforce principle of least privilege: scope down 'Action: *' to explicit service APIs.

rules.name: Publicly Readable Object Storage Bucket
rules.remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the account and bucket level immediately.

rules.name: Legacy IMDSv1 Enabled on Compute Instance
rules.remediation: Enforce IMDSv2 tokens (HttpTokens=required) to mitigate Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).

rules.name: Unrotated Stale IAM Access Key (>90 Days)
rules.remediation: Rotate access key pair and automate rotation lifecycle via secrets manager.
